poolside/laguna-s-2.1.description: NeuroLink default. Vendor statements about Laguna S 2.1 on https://docs.poolside.ai/get-started/supported-models.md (retrieved 2026-09-29): Parameters "118B total, 8B active per token"; Context window "1M tokens"; Model type "Mixture of Experts"; Modality "Text-to-text"; Reasoning "Native reasoning with thinking on or off per request". The same page says "Model availability, provider-specific variants, and model IDs can vary by access method." https://docs.poolside.ai/release-notes/models.md (retrieved 2026-09-29) says Laguna S 2.1 is "built for agentic coding and long-horizon work" and "is text-to-text and does not support vision inputs", so vision is false. The id poolside/laguna-s-2.1 is the model id in the quickstart on https://docs.poolside.ai/api/overview.md and in the examples on https://docs.poolside.ai/api/openai-api-examples.md, which use base URL https://inference.poolside.ai/v1.

errorRules.message: Poolside rejected the request's authentication (HTTP 401; an unauthenticated GET of /models answered the plain-text body "No Authorization header provided", and https://docs.poolside.ai/api/overview.md says "Send it as a Bearer token in the Authorization header"). Check {apiKeyEnvVar}. Create a key: {setupUrl}

Poolside returned HTTP 403 (https://docs.poolside.ai/cli/troubleshooting.md lists "403 Forbidden: please check the api-key you provided" under "Fix API key or token errors"). Check {apiKeyEnvVar}. Create a key: {setupUrl}

instructions: 1. Visit: https://platform.poolside.ai/ — https://docs.poolside.ai/get-started/log-in.md says of the Poolside Platform option: "sign in to Poolside Platform or create an account"
2. Create an API key: https://docs.poolside.ai/api/overview.md says "Sign in to Poolside Platform, open the API Keys tab, and click New key."

3. Billing as the vendor states it: https://docs.poolside.ai/get-started/log-in.md describes the Poolside Platform option as "free developer access" and says "The API key created through Poolside Platform is for Poolside-hosted inference."

4. Authentication is HTTP Bearer: https://docs.poolside.ai/api/overview.md shows the header "Authorization: Bearer <api-key>" and exports the key as POOLSIDE_API_KEY, the name NeuroLink reads. Set {apiKeyEnvVar} in your .env file
setup.description: Docs-verified only: the vendor's GET https://inference.poolside.ai/v1/models needs a key (it answers HTTP 401 without one), so the model id comes from the Poolside API page (https://docs.poolside.ai/api/overview.md, retrieved 2026-09-29) and the roster has not been checked; the entry is not yet live-verified. OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://inference.poolside.ai/v1: the overview page opens with "Call Poolside models through an OpenAI-compatible API.", its Access methods table lists "Poolside-hosted inference" with base URL https://inference.poolside.ai/v1, its Available endpoints table lists GET /v1/models and POST /v1/chat/completions, and its quickstart shows the OpenAI Python SDK and the OpenAI TypeScript SDK with base URL "https://inference.poolside.ai/v1". Unauthenticated GETs made 2026-09-29: /models answered HTTP 401 with content-type text/plain and the body "No Authorization header provided"; /chat/completions answered HTTP 405 with an empty body. No POST request was sent. errorRules: the 401 rule is built from the observed /models response (a plain-text body, so the rule matches the status code); the 403 rule is built from https://docs.poolside.ai/cli/troubleshooting.md, which lists "403 Forbidden: please check the api-key you provided" under "Fix API key or token errors". capabilities.streaming is true because https://docs.poolside.ai/api/openai-api-examples.md documents setting stream to true to receive "a series of chunks returned as server-sent events". capabilities.tools is true because that page's "Extend models with tools" section says "You can extend a model's capabilities by providing tools that it can call during a conversation." and shows a tools array and a returned tool_calls array on poolside/laguna-s-2.1 against https://inference.poolside.ai/v1/chat/completions. capabilities.toolsWithStreaming and capabilities.structuredOutputWithTools are false because no request combining them was sent. capabilities.structuredOutput is false because no request using response_format was sent. capabilities.embeddings is false; the overview page's Available endpoints table lists two endpoints, GET /v1/models and POST /v1/chat/completions. capabilities.thinking is false because this entry sends no thinking request parameter; https://docs.poolside.ai/api/openai-api-examples.md documents setting chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking to false to turn thinking off for a request. quirks.replayReasoningContent is set because https://docs.poolside.ai/api/openai-api-examples.md says "For agentic workflows with Poolside models, preserve reasoning_content from assistant responses when you include those responses in follow-up requests." and "Dropping previous reasoning content can prevent the model from reasoning in later steps."; no multi-turn request was sent. models.defaultContextWindow (128000) is a placeholder, not a vendor figure; it applies to poolside/laguna-s-2.1 because the catalog entry sets no contextWindow for it. models.defaultMaxOutputTokens (32768) equals the max_tokens default in the Control generation table on https://docs.poolside.ai/api/openai-api-examples.md; it is not a per-model limit. The model's status field holds production, a placeholder for a value the catalog schema requires; it is not a vendor statement. billingPolicy holds free-tier, one of the three values the catalog schema allows (free-tier, free-with-card, no-free-tier). Vendor wording, from https://docs.poolside.ai/get-started/log-in.md: the Poolside Platform option is for "free developer access", and "The API key created through Poolside Platform is for Poolside-hosted inference." apiKeyFormat is null, so NeuroLink's key-format check is not applied.

rosterVerified.method: docs-only — unauthenticated GET https://inference.poolside.ai/v1/models answers 401 without a key, so model ids are taken from https://docs.poolside.ai/api/overview.md (retrieved 2026-09-29); roster not verified

authProbe.method: unauthenticated GET https://inference.poolside.ai/v1/models with no credentials — HTTP 401, content-type text/plain; charset=utf-8, plain-text body "No Authorization header provided"; the body is not JSON and has no code field, so no code is recorded; the same day an unauthenticated GET https://inference.poolside.ai/v1/chat/completions answered HTTP 405 with an empty body; credential-free, no key used, no POST request sent

billingProbe.method: public page https://docs.poolside.ai/get-started/log-in.md (the Poolside Platform login option described as "free developer access"; "The API key created through Poolside Platform is for Poolside-hosted inference."); https://platform.poolside.ai/ opened and shows the title Poolside Platform; credential-free, no signup performed
